units.source_text: 我走到走廊上，招了招手。

en.t: I went out onto the veranda and beckoned with my hand.

units.source_text: 艺人们在庭院里耳语了几句，就绕到大门口去。

en.t: The entertainers whispered a few words in the courtyard, then went around to the front gate.

units.source_text: 三个姑娘从汉子身后挨个向走廊这边说了声“晚上好”，便垂下手施了个礼，看上去一副艺伎的风情。

en.t: One by one, the three girls, from behind the man, said "Good evening" toward the veranda, then lowered their hands and bowed, looking every bit like geisha.

units.source_text: 棋盘上霎时出现了我的败局。

en.t: In an instant, my losing position appeared on the game board.
